narrative.overview:
The page is a code review of a job application. Claims are diff lines; every line carries a blame column that names the fact it rests on, and the reviewer's comments sit on the lines they caught.

The ground is a cool violet-grey review paper with white sheets for every file, diff and comment. One indigo owns structure. Colour beyond that is state and nothing else.

Density sits between documentation and a review tool: large confident grotesk headings, generous section spacing, and mono only where the content is code, data, file names or verdicts.
keyCharacteristics: A full-height indigo rail on desktop that becomes a top bar on phones.
Diff hunks with line numbers, a sign column and a blame column as the main content surface.
Review comments as the only lifted surfaces.
Verdict tokens (FIX, SHIP, APPLY, SKIP, QUALIFY FIRST, strong, partial, gap) in a fixed colour law.

rules.name: The Colour Law Rule
rules.body: Rose only for what may not be written, mint only for what traces and ships, amber only for partial and QUALIFY FIRST. No state colour ever decorates.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo is structure and action, never a background wash for content.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono is for code, file names, fact ids, commands and verdicts. Claims, headings and explanations stay in the grotesk.

rules.name: The Only The Reviewer Floats Rule
rules.body: A review comment is the one surface that lifts off the sheet.

dos: Do trace every visible claim in a demo to a file in the example and label invented material as invented.
Do keep state colours to their law: rose (#99152f) removed and FIX, mint (#12633a) added and SHIP, amber (#734700) partial.
Do draw icons as SVG with a 1.5px stroke.
Do keep the strike-through draw as the only entrance motion, and switch it off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use em or en dashes anywhere in copy.
Don't set prose, headings or explanations in mono.
Don't add shadows to anything but review comments.
Don't use counts, stars, testimonials or prices as proof.
